name: AE Mail
migrationPolicy: Workload is an immutable GHCR image release, not a mounted code tree. Keep mountedRelease.enabled false. Image or compose changes rebuild the runtime only. Mail-data volumes stay outside this recipe. HTTP health is GET /api/health on container port 7090. Do not treat this as a port-25 mail-server app. A Mail change must never deploy Public or Staff code.
rollbackPolicy: Roll back by restoring the previous runtime image pointer. Do not flip a mounted current symlink. Unhealthy new image is not left serving.
